rules: Sitemap lastmod is a modification signal, never datePublished or automatic validation.
A source-page review does not validate gated whitepapers, downloads, forms or recordings.
Unknown publishers, press intermediaries, duplicate releases and purely corporate personnel/award news are not automatically imported.
Secondary HR, production and marketing APIs were sampled; not an exhaustive editorial review of all discovered URLs.
Existing IDs, primary provider names, source URLs and validated asset IDs are preserved.
